questions.q: A country has a birth rate of 28 per 1,000 and a death rate of 8 per 1,000. What is its natural change?
Which feature shows a youthful population on a population pyramid?
options: A narrow base and a wide top
A wide base that narrows quickly with age
questions.why: A wide base means a high birth rate; the quick narrowing shows high death rates and low life expectancy.

options: Fines for having a second child
Cash payments and paid leave for parents
questions.why: Pro-natalist policies encourage more births, e.g. payments and parental leave.

questions.q: Explain one problem caused by China's one-child policy.
questions.model: It led to an ageing population: with few children born, there are fewer workers to pay taxes and support a growing number of elderly people.
points: valid problem (ageing population, more males than females, 4-2-1 problem, human rights)
developed explanation of why it is a problem
